title: Correction to 20261025T1052-c07-metabolic-no-shell-needed: its fork.txt was overwritten by a stale script; the regenerated readout matches the published numbers
summary: In 20261025T1052-c07-metabolic-no-shell-needed the file fork.txt holds a Python traceback (a leftover background script rewrote it before the commit) and the *_seed6_catalyst.txt files are empty (seed 6 blows up). I re-ran the same four arms unchanged (full world seed 7; no gate with Dc 0.01 seed 7; Dc 0.03 seeds 7 and 5) and ran c03's fork.py from t=200: full 26 -> 61 bodies, 24/26 founders alive; Dc 0.01 41 -> 48, 39/41; Dc 0.03 26 -> 30 and 26 -> 26, all alive. These are the numbers in that contribution's README and finding, which stand; use this fork.txt as its evidence.
